Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Robert Souder wrote:
>
> Does an Assamite need to become Camarilla to become the
> Prince of Istanbul or it this vote vote an exception to
> the rule?

No exception is listed on the card text, so an Assamite
would need to be Camarilla in order to call the vote.

> Also I am pretty sure one of the these card listings are
> wrong. Found on your web site.
>
> Revocation of Tyre
> Political Action
> Political Card-Worth 1 Vote Called by any at vampire +1
> stealth If this vote is successful, all Assamites are
> considered Camarilla vampires for the rest of the game.
> All options available to Camarilla clans are now open to
> the Assamites.
>
> Treaty of Tyre Enforced
> Political Action
> Political Card-Worth 1 Vote Called by any vampire at +1
> stealth If this vote is successful, all Assamaties are
> considered Camarilla vampires for the rest of game. All
> options available to Camarilla clans are now open to the
> Assamites.

Yes, the lists on the WotC web site (which are the same
lists used by the search engine on the Rulemonger sites)
have a few errors. The actual card text for Treaty of Tyre
Enforced is:

Political Card - Worth 1 Vote Called by any vampire at
+1 stealth. If this vote is successful, each Methuselah
burns X+1 pool, where X is the number of Assamites he/she
controls.
